name: inspect_item
description:
Return complete readable detail for exactly one item already placed on a timeline.

Use item ids or prefixes from preview_timeline. The result includes identity, timeline and track, timeline/source ranges, asset reference, playback state, geometry, crop/fit/position/scale/rotation/opacity, fades and audio state, item-type-specific properties, Motion Graphic defaults/overrides, and attached effects/transitions when present.

This reads placed-item instances. Use inspect_asset for the source asset and preview_timeline for surrounding timeline structure or composed pixels.

itemId.description: Exactly one placed item id or unambiguous id prefix.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

timelineId.description: Optional timeline id/prefix that narrows item lookup without switching the active timeline.
